<plan_mode_respond>
<response>You're asking for an architecture that makes “zoro plan” the first-class orchestrator before any big action, stores/updates plan JSON in the generated folder, auto-appends nodes, and drives the frontend differently per node type with specific behaviors and rule adherence.

Here’s a concrete, end-to-end plan that covers CLI, backend JSON storage, and frontend adaptation.

High-level architecture

- Single source of truth: .zoro/generated/plan.json
  - Stores the execution plan (list of nodes, edges, metadata, audit logs, user answers, substeps, rule checks, timestamps).
  - Updated by both the CLI (zoro plan, zoro plan-2, zoro search, zoro recover) and the API as needed.
- Node schema with types and required fields:
  - checking-with-user
    - fields: questions[], answers[], transcript, status, completed_at
    - rules: must persist the user’s answers; the frontend should present a Q&A interface; when done, write answers back into node.answers and a transcript into node.transcript
  - planning
    - fields: plan_inputs, generated_nodes[], cascaded_changes[], status
    - rules: call zoro plan-2 to append/modify nodes; on completion, generated_nodes are appended with correct edges
  - implementation
    - fields: substeps[], substep_results[], rules_checked[], status
    - rules: every substep must be marked complete with evidence; must record which rules were checked and how they were satisfied
  - debugging
    - fields: cursor_prompt_used, findings[], added_nodes[], status
    - rules: invoke standard cursor prompt; optionally call zoro plan to add nodes that emerge from debugging
  - testing (if/when used)
    - fields: test_matrix[], runs[], results[], status
- Frontend adapts rendering by node.type:
  - checking-with-user: show a “Questionnaire” surface; after completion, persist answers/transcript into the node and lock it
  - planning: show “Plan Builder” UI with a button that triggers zoro plan-2 flows (through API), then reflect new nodes on canvas
  - implementation: show substeps UI (checklist). Enforce rule checks before marking the node complete. Persist substep results, rule confirmations
  - debugging: show “Debug Console” with cursor prompt helper; allow adding new nodes via “Create plan nodes from findings”
  - All nodes: show Rules Guidance (readable list of applicable rules) and require explicit confirmation on completion

Decision logic: when to run zoro plan vs zoro search

- Before any big thing:
  1) If .zoro/generated/plan.json doesn’t exist or has zero nodes → run zoro plan "task description"
  2) If plan exists but you need context retrieval (“what files/functions exist?”) without changing the plan → run zoro search "query"
  3) If plan exists and you’ve learned something requiring new/updated nodes → run zoro plan-2 "refined query" (append nodes/edges)
- The frontend should make this automatic:
  - On “Start task” action, check existence of plan.json
  - If missing: display inline banner with “Create Plan” (calls API endpoint that shells zoro plan)
  - If present: show plan view and a “Search” bar (zoro search) along with “Refine Plan” action (zoro plan-2)

How to run zoro plan (operational)

- CLI:
  - zoro plan "Summarized task from user" --output .clinerules/zoro_plan.md
  - Additionally the command should also write/update .zoro/generated/plan.json (canonical). If not implemented yet, we add that to backend/cli/commands/plan.py.
  - Subsequent refinement: zoro plan-2 "refine/add nodes" (appends into plan.json)
  - If we need file-centric context first: zoro search "area" to gather info that feeds into zoro plan
- Frontend:
  - POST /api/plan { description } → server runs zoro plan ...; returns updated plan.json; log “POST /api/plan - Started/Success/Failed” to terminal
  - POST /api/plan-2 { refinement } → server runs zoro plan-2 ...; returns updated plan.json
  - POST /api/search { query } → server runs zoro search ...; returns results; does NOT mutate plan.json

Plan JSON schema (proposal)

- .zoro/generated/plan.json
  - version: number
  - created_at, updated_at
  - nodes: [
      {
        id: string,
        type: "checking-with-user" | "planning" | "implementation" | "debugging" | "testing",
        title: string,
        description: string,
        status: "pending" | "in_progress" | "completed" | "blocked",
        rules: [ { id, name, description, source } ],
        data: {
          // type-specific fields
          // checking-with-user
          questions?: [ { id, text } ],
          answers?: [ { question_id, answer, timestamp } ],
          transcript?: string,
          // planning
          plan_inputs?: any,
          generated_nodes?: string[],
          cascaded_changes?: any[],
          // implementation
          substeps?: [ { id, title, done: boolean, evidence?: string } ],
          substep_results?: any[],
          rules_checked?: [ { rule_id, satisfied: boolean, notes?: string } ],
          // debugging
          cursor_prompt_used?: string,
          findings?: any[],
          added_nodes?: string[],
          // testing
          test_matrix?: any[],
          runs?: any[],
          results?: any[]
        },
        audit: [ { at, who, action, details } ]
      }
    ]
  - edges: [ { id, from, to, type?: "sequence" | "dependency" } ]
  - history: [ { at, action, details } ]

Backend changes

- Extend CLI commands:
  - plan.py: after generating the markdown plan (.clinerules/zoro_plan.md), also produce/merge into .zoro/generated/plan.json (append nodes; preserve IDs; maintain edges)
  - plan-2: open plan.json, append/refine nodes, set edges; keep history entry; write back
  - search.py: read-only, returns structured results (paths, functions, symbols); optionally also write a search cache at .zoro/generated/search_cache.json
  - recover.py: write a .clinerules/zoro_recovery.md and optionally add a “recovery” planning node to plan.json
- API surface (Flask):
  - POST /api/plan: { description } → runs zoro plan; returns plan.json
  - POST /api/plan-2: { refinement } → runs zoro plan-2; returns plan.json
  - POST /api/search: { query } → runs zoro search; returns results
  - GET /api/plan → returns .zoro/generated/plan.json
  - PUT /api/plan/nodes/:id → update a node’s data/status (e.g., write answers, substeps, rule confirmations)
- Logging:
  - Terminal: “POST /api/plan - Started”, “Success (200)”, “Failed …”
  - Frontend: node-type-specific UI logs only (no API lifecycle spam)

Frontend changes

- Plan-aware WorkflowEditor:
  - On load: GET /api/plan
    - If 404/missing: render “Create Plan” panel + text input → POST /api/plan
    - If present: render graph from nodes/edges (React Flow)
  - Node renderer dispatches by type:
    - checking-with-user: QuestionList + AnswerRecorder
      - On submit: PUT /api/plan/nodes/:id with answers[] and transcript; set status completed; auto-advance
    - planning: PlanRefinement panel
      - “Refine Plan” → POST /api/plan-2; refresh plan
    - implementation: SubstepChecklist
      - Mark each substep done and attach evidence; RulesChecklist must be satisfied to complete node
    - debugging: CursorPromptPanel
      - Run standard prompt, capture findings; “Create follow-up nodes” → POST /api/plan-2 with findings summary; refresh plan
  - DetailsPanel adds a Rules tab (read-only rules at this node) and an Audit tab
  - LogPanel stays terminal-style, collapsible, bottom

Rule system

- rules are attached per node at creation time (from templates)
- rules_checked in implementation nodes must be completed to mark node done
- system supports “rule improvements”: when patterns are detected (e.g., you always need to add X), a debugging/planning node can propose new rule text and a small PR to rule templates (templates/rules/*.md or backend/globals/task_types.py extension)

Auto-improvement loop

- When the agent recognizes repeat patterns:
  - Create a “planning” node titled “Refine rules for [node type]”
  - Node content proposes new/edited rules
  - On “Apply”, write back to a rule template file and to plan.json history
  - Future nodes of that type include the improved rules automatically

How I would run zoro plan operationally

- From CLI
  - zoro plan "Implement staged ProcessingPanel with parsing→categorizing→learning" --output .clinerules/zoro_plan.md
  - The command writes both .clinerules/zoro_plan.md and .zoro/generated/plan.json
- From frontend
  - POST /api/plan with description captured from the user’s “Task Summary” input
  - The backend executes the CLI command (or directly calls the same underlying planner library) and returns the updated plan.json
  - The UI then renders nodes and edges; the current node type dictates the UI surface
- After a planning node finishes or when new info is learned
  - zoro plan-2 "Append implementation substeps for ProcessingPanel and add debugging node for post-learn click handler"
  - UI calls /api/plan-2; backend updates plan.json; React Flow refreshes with new nodes

Guardrails and failure points

- Always check for plan.json before working; fail fast with a single-click “Create Plan” action
- Keep plan.json canonical; markdown is human-readable, but not authoritative
- Lock node completion behind required fields:
  - checking-with-user must have answers[] and transcript
  - implementation must have all substeps done and rules_checked satisfied
- Avoid mixing concerns: backend lifecycle logs in terminal; UI shows node-specific interactions only
- Version plan.json (version field and history array) to support evolution and recovery

Proposed next steps

- Backend
  - Extend CLI plan/plan-2 to read/write .zoro/generated/plan.json canonically
  - Add Flask endpoints: /api/plan, /api/plan-2, /api/search, /api/plan (GET), /api/plan/nodes/:id (PUT)
  - Add rule templates and a small registry (can reuse backend/globals/task_types.py for task types + rule templates)
- Frontend
  - On boot: GET /api/plan; gate UI accordingly
  - Implement NodeType renderers: CheckingWithUserPanel, PlanRefinementPanel, SubstepChecklistPanel, DebugConsolePanel
  - Wire node update calls to PUT /api/plan/nodes/:id
- Migration
  - Seed plan.json from current .clinerules/zoro_plan.md
  - Define minimal rule templates for the four node types

If you want me to implement, toggle to Act mode. I’ll:
- Define the plan.json schema in backend/globals/schemas.py
- Update backend/cli/commands/plan.py and plan-2 to write/merge plan.json
- Add /api/plan*, /api/search routes
- Add frontend adapters and node-type components
- Migrate your existing plan to plan.json
</response>

# Zoro Learning System - Node-Based Planning Workflow

## BEFORE STARTING ANY TASK

**NODE-BASED WORKFLOW:** Before implementing any task, you MUST:

1. **Generate execution plan**:
   ```bash
   zoro plan "<task description>" --output .clinerules/zoro_plan.md
   ```

2. **Read the generated plan**:
   ```bash
   read_file .clinerules/zoro_plan.md
   ```
   DO NOT GENERATE A PLAN IN A DIFFERENT FILE. REPLACE THE EXISTING FILE IF THERE IS A NEW PLAN.

3. **Follow the plan**:
   - Execute steps in order based on their node type
   - Apply rules listed for each step
   - Monitor for failure points mentioned in each step
   - If a step is type "planning", run `zoro plan-2` after completing it

4. **If you detect a failure point**:
   - Stop current approach
   - Refer to the guardrail in the plan
   - Adjust and continue with the lesson learned

## Node Types

Plans are structured using 5 node types that define how to approach each step:

### 1. checking-with-user
**Purpose:** Align intent with user to fully understand requirements
**Output:** Requirements checklist for user validation
**Example:** "List out all requirements for the login form and confirm with user"

### 2. planning
**Purpose:** Reflect on what you know/don't know, figure out next steps
**Action:** After completing this step, run:
```bash
zoro plan-2 "<refined query based on what you learned>" --output .clinerules/zoro_plan.md
```
This extends the existing plan with new steps based on updated context.

### 3. code-style
**Purpose:** Implement code with focus on readability, naming, documentation
**Key Feature:** Contains **substeps** for incremental implementation
**Example substeps:**
1. Create basic component structure
2. Add form validation logic
3. Implement error handling

Each substep implements a couple features at a time - DO NOT implement everything at once.

### 4. debugging
**Purpose:** Identify and fix errors or broken logic
**Approach:** Use cursor refresh.py method

### 5. testing
**Purpose:** Verify correctness and robustness
**Output:** Test patterns and test generation

## Iterative Planning with plan-2

When a plan includes a "planning" node, you'll refine your understanding and extend the plan:

1. **Complete the planning step** (gather info, explore codebase, etc.)
2. **Run iterative plan:**
   ```bash
   zoro plan-2 "add validation and error handling to login form" --output .clinerules/zoro_plan.md
   ```
3. **Read updated plan** - it will contain both old and new steps
4. **Continue execution** from where you left off

The `plan-2` command reads the existing plan and appends/refines it rather than creating from scratch.

## Failure Detection

Watch for these indicators that you may have hit a failure point:
- User asks you to redo something you just did
- User corrects assumptions you made
- User says "no" or "that's not what I meant"
- You're building something without full requirements
- You're installing packages without confirmation

When detected:
1. **If guardrail is clear** - Apply it directly and adjust approach
2. **If significantly off-track** - Generate recovery plan:
   ```bash
   zoro recover "jumped to code without confirming user flow"
   ```
3. **Read both plans**:
   ```bash
   read_file .clinerules/zoro_plan.md      # Original goal
   read_file .clinerules/zoro_recovery.md   # How to recover
   ```
4. **Execute recovery steps** then delete .clinerules/zoro_recover.md resume original plan

)
from pathlib import Path


def load_task_descriptions() -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    all_tasks = load_all_analyzed_tasks()
    return [(t.task_id, t.task) for t in all_tasks]


def load_tasks_by_ids(task_ids: List[str]) -> List[AnalyzedTaskV3]:
    all_tasks = load_all_analyzed_tasks()
    return [t for t in all_tasks if t.task_id in task_ids]


def select_relevant_tasks_for_analysis(query: str, task_descriptions: List[Tuple[str, str]], model: str = 'gpt-5') -> List[str]:
    provider = get_default_provider()
    
    formatted_descriptions = "\n".join([f"{task_id}: {desc}" for task_id, desc in task_descriptions])
    
    prompt = TASK_SELECTION_PROMPT.format(
        query=query,
        task_descriptions=formatted_descriptions
    )
    
    response = provider.chat_completion(
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        model=model
    )
    
    data = json.loads(response)
    return data.get("task_ids", [])


def generate_plan_structure(query: str, relevant_tasks: List[AnalyzedTaskV3], model: str = 'gpt-5') -> Plan:
    provider = get_default_provider()
    
    good_tasks = [t for t in relevant_tasks if t.type == "good"]
    bad_tasks = [t for t in relevant_tasks if t.type == "bad"]
    
    good_summaries = []
    for t in good_tasks:
        summary = f"Task: {t.task}\nDescription: {t.description}\nReasoning: {t.reasoning}"
        good_summaries.append(summary)
    
    bad_summaries = []
    for t in bad_tasks:
        summary = f"Task: {t.task}\nDescription: {t.description}\nProblem: {t.problem}\nFailure Point: {t.failure_point}\nGuardrail: {t.guardrail}"
        bad_summaries.append(summary)
    
    good_text = "\n\n".join(good_summaries) if good_summaries else "None"
    bad_text = "\n\n".join(bad_summaries) if bad_summaries else "None"
    
    prompt = PLAN_STRUCTURE_PROMPT.format(
        query=query,
        good_tasks=good_text,
        bad_tasks=bad_text
    )
    
    response = provider.chat_completion(
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        model=model,
        response_format=get_schema(Plan.model_json_schema())
    )
    
    plan_data = json.loads(response)
    return Plan(**plan_data)

    provider = get_default_provider()
    
    formatted_descriptions = "\n".join([f"{task_id}: {desc}" for task_id, desc in task_descriptions])
    
    prompt = STEP_TASK_SELECTION_PROMPT.format(

        task_descriptions=formatted_descriptions
    )
    
    response = provider.chat_completion(
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        model=model
    )
    
    data = json.loads(response)
    return data.get("task_ids", [])


def select_rules_for_step(step_objective: str, rules: List[RuleV2], limit: int = 5, model: str = 'gpt-5') -> List[RuleV2]:
    provider = get_default_provider()
    
    formatted_rules = []
    for rule in rules:
        formatted_rules.append(f"ID: {rule.rule_id}\nRule: {rule.rule}\nReasoning: {rule.reasoning}")
    
    rules_text = "\n\n".join(formatted_rules)
    
    prompt = STEP_RULE_SELECTION_PROMPT.format(
        step_objective=step_objective,
        rules=rules_text,
        limit=limit
    )
    
    response = provider.chat_completion(
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        model=model
    )
    
    data = json.loads(response)
    selected_ids = data.get("rule_ids", [])
    
    return [r for r in rules if r.rule_id in selected_ids]


def generate_plan(task_query: str, model: str = 'gpt-5') -> Plan:
    print(f"Generating plan for: {task_query}")
    
    print("\nStage 1: Initial task analysis...")
    task_descriptions = load_task_descriptions()
    
    if not task_descriptions:
        print("No tasks found in database. Run 'zoro process' first.")
        return Plan(
            task_query=task_query,
            reasoning="No past tasks available for analysis",
            steps=[]
        )
    
    print(f"  Found {len(task_descriptions)} total tasks")
    
    relevant_task_ids = select_relevant_tasks_for_analysis(task_query, task_descriptions, model)
    print(f"  Selected {len(relevant_task_ids)} relevant tasks")
    
    relevant_tasks = load_tasks_by_ids(relevant_task_ids)
    
    plan = generate_plan_structure(task_query, relevant_tasks, model)
    print(f"  Generated plan with {len(plan.steps)} steps")
    
    print("\nStage 2: Per-step rule retrieval...")
    for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps, 1):
        print(f"  Step {i}: {step.objective[:60]}...")
        
        step_query = step.objective
        step_task_ids = select_tasks_for_step(step_query, task_descriptions, model)
        print(f"    Found {len(step_task_ids)} relevant tasks")
        
        step_tasks = load_tasks_by_ids(step_task_ids)
        all_step_rules = [rule for task in step_tasks for rule in task.rules]
        print(f"    Total {len(all_step_rules)} rules available")
        
        if all_step_rules:
            step.rules = select_rules_for_step(step.objective, all_step_rules, limit=10, model=model)
            print(f"    Selected {len(step.rules)} rules")
    
    print("\n✓ Plan generation complete")
    return plan


def generate_recovery_plan(failure_description: str, model: str = 'gpt-5') -> RecoveryPlan:
    print(f"Generating recovery plan...")
    
    plan_path = Path(".clinerules/zoro_plan.md")
    original_task = "unknown"
    original_steps = "No original plan found"
    
    if plan_path.exists():
        with open(plan_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            content = f.read()
            if content.startswith("# Plan: "):
                original_task = content.split('\n')[0].replace("# Plan: ", "").strip()
            
            steps_section = []
            in_execution_plan = False
            for line in content.split('\n'):
                if '## Execution Plan' in line:
                    in_execution_plan = True
                    continue
                if in_execution_plan and line.startswith('### Step'):
                    steps_section.append(line)
            
            if steps_section:
                original_steps = "\n".join(steps_section)
    
    print(f"  Original task: {original_task}")
    
    task_descriptions = load_task_descriptions()
    
    if not task_descriptions:
        print("  No past tasks available")
        return RecoveryPlan(
            task_query=original_task,
            what_went_wrong=failure_description,
            immediate_fix=["Address the issue described", "Resume original plan"],
            resume_at="Continue from where you left off"
        )
    
    failure_query = f"failure: {failure_description}"
    relevant_task_ids = select_relevant_tasks_for_analysis(failure_query, task_descriptions, model)
    print(f"  Found {len(relevant_task_ids)} similar past failures")
    
    relevant_tasks = load_tasks_by_ids(relevant_task_ids)
    bad_tasks = [t for t in relevant_tasks if t.type == "bad"]
    
    similar_failures = []
    for t in bad_tasks:
        if t.failure_point and t.guardrail:
            similar_failures.append(
                f"Task: {t.task}\nFailure: {t.failure_point}\nGuardrail: {t.guardrail}"
            )
    
    failures_text = "\n\n".join(similar_failures) if similar_failures else "No similar past failures found"
    
    prompt = RECOVERY_PROMPT.format(
        task_query=original_task,
        original_steps=original_steps,
        failure_description=failure_description,
        similar_failures=failures_text
    )
    
    provider = get_default_provider()
    response = provider.chat_completion(
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        model=model,
        response_format=get_schema(RecoveryPlan.model_json_schema())
    )
    
    recovery_data = json.loads(response)
    recovery_plan = RecoveryPlan(**recovery_data)
    
    print("✓ Recovery plan generated")
    return recovery_plan

from __future__ import annotations
import json
from typing import List, Tuple

from backend.globals.models import get_default_provider
from backend.globals.schemas import RuleV2
from backend.learner.learning import load_all_analyzed_tasks
from backend.assistant.prompts.search import CLASSIFY_QUERY_PROMPT, RANK_RULES_PROMPT


def llm_classify_query(query: str, model: str = 'gpt-5') -> str:
    provider = get_default_provider()
    
    prompt = CLASSIFY_QUERY_PROMPT.format(query=query)
    
    response = provider.chat_completion(
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        model=model
    )
    
    data = json.loads(response)
    return data["task_type"]


def filter_rules_by_type(task_type: str) -> List[RuleV2]:
    all_tasks = load_all_analyzed_tasks()
    
    all_rules = []
    for task in all_tasks:
        all_rules.extend(task.rules)
    
    tag = f"[{task_type}]"
    filtered = [rule for rule in all_rules if rule.rule.startswith(tag)]
    
    return filtered


def llm_rank_rules(query: str, rules: List[RuleV2], limit: int = 10, model: str = 'gpt-5') -> List[RuleV2]:
    if not rules:
        return []
    
    if len(rules) <= limit:
        return rules
    
    provider = get_default_provider()
    
    formatted_rules = "\n".join([
        f"{i+1}. {rule.rule}"
        for i, rule in enumerate(rules)
    ])
    
    prompt = RANK_RULES_PROMPT.format(
        query=query,
        rules=formatted_rules,
        limit=limit
    )
    
    response = provider.chat_completion(
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        model=model
    )
    
    data = json.loads(response)
    rule_numbers = data["rule_numbers"]
    
    ranked_rules = []
    for num in rule_numbers:
        if 0 < num <= len(rules):
            ranked_rules.append(rules[num - 1])
    
    return ranked_rules


def search_by_type(query: str, limit: int = 10, model: str = 'gpt-5') -> Tuple[str, List[RuleV2]]:
    task_type = llm_classify_query(query, model)
    
    filtered_rules = filter_rules_by_type(task_type)
    
    ranked_rules = llm_rank_rules(query, filtered_rules, limit, model)
    
    return task_type, ranked_rules

```
   → Human-readable version
```

- Different purposes: generate content vs track execution
- Fully compatible: planner creates, plan_manager persists

**No conflicts:**
- planner.py doesn't touch filesystem (just returns Plan objects)
- plan_manager.py doesn't generate content (just reads/writes files)
- retrieval.py is independent (search-only)

import json
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional, List

from backend.globals.schemas import (
    ChatsMetadataDB,
    ChatMetadata,
    PlanModel,
    PlanNode,
    PlanEdge,
    HistoryEntry
)


ASSISTANT_DIR = Path.cwd() / ".zoro" / "generated" / "assistant"
METADATA_PATH = ASSISTANT_DIR / "metadata.json"


def load_metadata() -> ChatsMetadataDB:
    if not METADATA_PATH.exists():
        return ChatsMetadataDB()
    
    with open(METADATA_PATH, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    
    return ChatsMetadataDB(**data)


def save_metadata(metadata: ChatsMetadataDB) -> None:
    ASSISTANT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    with open(METADATA_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(metadata.model_dump(), f, indent=2)


def load_plan(chat_id: str) -> Optional[PlanModel]:
    plan_path = ASSISTANT_DIR / chat_id / "plan.json"
    
    if not plan_path.exists():
        return None
    
    with open(plan_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    
    return PlanModel(**data)


def save_plan(chat_id: str, plan: PlanModel) -> None:
    plan_dir = ASSISTANT_DIR / chat_id
    plan_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    plan_path = plan_dir / "plan.json"
    
    with open(plan_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(plan.model_dump(by_alias=True), f, indent=2)


def merge_plan(chat_id: str, new_nodes: List[PlanNode], new_edges: List[PlanEdge]) -> PlanModel:
    existing_plan = load_plan(chat_id)
    
    if not existing_plan:
        now = datetime.now().isoformat()
        existing_plan = PlanModel(
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            nodes=[],
            edges=[],
            history=[]
        )
    
    existing_node_ids = {node.id for node in existing_plan.nodes}
    
    for node in new_nodes:
        if node.id not in existing_node_ids:
            existing_plan.nodes.append(node)
    
    existing_edge_ids = {edge.id for edge in existing_plan.edges}
    
    for edge in new_edges:
        if edge.id not in existing_edge_ids:
            existing_plan.edges.append(edge)
    
    now = datetime.now().isoformat()
    existing_plan.updated_at = now
    
    existing_plan.history.append(
        HistoryEntry(
            at=now,
            action="merge",
            details=f"Added {len([n for n in new_nodes if n.id not in existing_node_ids])} nodes, {len([e for e in new_edges if e.id not in existing_edge_ids])} edges"
        )
    )
    
    save_plan(chat_id, existing_plan)
    
    return existing_plan

            md += "### Good Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.good_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
        
        if plan.bad_trajectories:
            md += "### Bad Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.bad_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
    
    if plan.reasoning:
        md += "## Reasoning\n\n"
        md += f"{plan.reasoning}\n\n"
    
    if plan.steps:
        md += "---\n\n## Execution Plan\n\n"
        
        for step in plan.steps:
            md += f"### Step {step.step_number}: [{step.task_type}] {step.objective}\n\n"
            
            if step.substeps:

            if step.rules:

                for rule in step.rules:
                    md += f"- {rule.rule}\n"
                    md += f"  Reasoning: {rule.reasoning}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.failure_point_watch:

#!/usr/bin/env python3

from dotenv import load_dotenv, find_dotenv
load_dotenv(find_dotenv(usecwd=True))

import sys
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import json

from backend.cli.commands import cmd_init, cmd_process, cmd_search, cmd_messages, cmd_plan, cmd_recover
from backend.utils import get_project_root

# Config file path
CONFIG_PATH = get_project_root() / ".zoro/config.json"

def load_config():
    if not CONFIG_PATH.exists():
        return None
    
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, 'r') as f:
        return json.load(f)

def save_config(config):
    CONFIG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(config, f, indent=2)

def mark_file_processed(filename):
    config = load_config()
    if not config:
        config = {"user_name": "", "processed_files": []}
    
    if "processed_files" not in config:
        config["processed_files"] = []
    
    if filename not in config["processed_files"]:
        config["processed_files"].append(filename)
        save_config(config)

def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description='Learning system CLI - process chat logs and search rules'
    )
    
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', help='Command to run')
    
    # Process command
    process_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'process',
        help='Process markdown chat logs into tasks and learn rules with trajectory analysis'
    )
    process_parser.add_argument(
        'file_path',
        nargs='?',
        help='Path to markdown chat file (optional - processes all unprocessed files if not provided)'
    )
    process_parser.add_argument(
        '--user-name',
        type=str,
        help='Name of the user for personalized learning (optional - uses config if not provided)'
    )
    
    # Init command
    init_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'init',
        help='Initialize zoro in the current project'
    )
    init_parser.add_argument(
        '--user-name',
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help='Your name for personalized learning'
    )
    
    # Search command
    search_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'search',
        help='Search for relevant rules'
    )
    search_parser.add_argument(
        'query',
        help='Search query string'
    )
    search_parser.add_argument(
        '--limit',
        type=int,
        default=5,
        help='Number of results to return (default: 5)'
    )
    search_parser.add_argument(
        '--output',
        type=str,
        help='Output markdown file path (e.g., .clinerules/context.md)'
    )
    
    # Messages command
    messages_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'messages',
        help='Extract and display user messages from a chat file'
    )
    messages_parser.add_argument(
        'file_path',
        help='Path to markdown chat file'
    )
    
    # Plan command
    plan_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'plan',
        help='Generate execution plan with rules and failure detection'
    )
    plan_parser.add_argument(
        'query',
        help='Task description to plan for'
    )
    plan_parser.add_argument(
        '--output',
        type=str,
        help='Output markdown file path (e.g., .clinerules/zoro_plan.md)'
    )
    
    # Recover command
    recover_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'recover',
        help='Generate recovery plan when execution goes off-track'
    )
    recover_parser.add_argument(
        'description',
        help='What went wrong (e.g., "jumped to code without confirming flow")'
    )
    
    return parser.parse_args()

def main():
    args = parse_args()
    
    if args.command == 'init':
        cmd_init(args, save_config)
    elif args.command == 'process':
        cmd_process(args, load_config, mark_file_processed)
    elif args.command == 'search':
        cmd_search(args)
    elif args.command == 'messages':
        cmd_messages(args)
    elif args.command == 'plan':
        cmd_plan(args)
    elif args.command == 'recover':
        cmd_recover(args)
    else:
        print("Please specify a command: 'init', 'process', 'search', 'plan', 'recover', or 'messages'")
        print("Use --help for more information")
        sys.exit(1)

def cli():
    main()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    cli()

def mark_file_processed(filename):

        save_config(config)

def parse_args():

    search_parser.add_argument(
        '--limit',

        default=5,

    )

    )
    
    # Messages command

        'messages',
        help='Extract and display user messages from a chat file'
    )
    messages_parser.add_argument(
        'file_path',
        help='Path to markdown chat file'
    )
    
    # Plan command
    plan_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'plan',
        help='Generate execution plan with rules and failure detection'
    )
    plan_parser.add_argument(
        'query',
        help='Task description to plan for'
    )
    plan_parser.add_argument(
        '--chat-id',
        type=str,
        help='Chat ID to associate this plan with (for persistence)'
    )
    plan_parser.add_argument(
        '--output',
        type=str,
        help='Output markdown file path (e.g., .clinerules/zoro_plan.md)'
    )
    
    # Plan-iter command
    plan_iter_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'plan-iter',

    )
    plan_iter_parser.add_argument(

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import uuid

from backend.assistant.planner import generate_plan
from backend.assistant.plan_manager import load_metadata, save_metadata, save_plan
from backend.globals.schemas import (
    Plan,
    PlanModel,
    PlanNode,
    PlanEdge,
    ChatMetadata,
    HistoryEntry
)


def format_plan_as_markdown(plan: Plan) -> str:
    md = f"# Plan: {plan.task_query}\n\n"
    
    if plan.good_trajectories or plan.bad_trajectories:
        md += "## Analysis of Past Similar Tasks\n\n"
        
        if plan.good_trajectories:
            md += "### Good Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.good_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
        
        if plan.bad_trajectories:
            md += "### Bad Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.bad_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
    
    if plan.reasoning:
        md += "## Reasoning\n\n"
        md += f"{plan.reasoning}\n\n"
    
    if plan.steps:
        md += "---\n\n## Execution Plan\n\n"
        
        for step in plan.steps:
            md += f"### Step {step.step_number}: [{step.task_type}] {step.objective}\n\n"
            
            if step.substeps:
                md += "**Substeps:**\n"
                for i, substep in enumerate(step.substeps, 1):
                    md += f"{i}. {substep}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.rules:
                md += "**Rules to follow:**\n"
                for rule in step.rules:
                    md += f"- {rule.rule}\n"
                    md += f"  Reasoning: {rule.reasoning}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.failure_point_watch:
                md += f"**Failure point watch:**\n⚠️ {step.failure_point_watch}\n\n"
            
            md += "---\n\n"
    
    return md


def convert_plan_to_model(plan: Plan) -> PlanModel:
    now = datetime.now().isoformat()
    
    nodes = []
    edges = []
    
    for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps):
        node_id = f"step-{step.step_number}"
        
        node = PlanNode(
            id=node_id,
            type=step.task_type if step.task_type in ["checking-with-user", "planning", "implementation", "debugging", "testing"] else "implementation",
            title=step.objective[:100],
            description=step.objective,
            status="pending",
            rules=[],
            data={},
            audit=[]
        )
        
        nodes.append(node)
        
        if i > 0:
            edge = PlanEdge(
                id=f"edge-{i}",
                from_node=f"step-{plan.steps[i-1].step_number}",
                to_node=node_id,
                type="sequence"
            )
            edges.append(edge)
    
    plan_model = PlanModel(
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        nodes=nodes,
        edges=edges,
        history=[
            HistoryEntry(
                at=now,
                action="created",
                details=f"Plan generated for: {plan.task_query}"
            )
        ]
    )
    
    return plan_model


def cmd_plan(args):
    try:
        query = args.query
        chat_id = args.chat_id
        
        plan = generate_plan(query, model='gpt-5')
        
        markdown = format_plan_as_markdown(plan)
        
        if args.output:
            output_path = Path(args.output)
            output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(markdown)
            
            print(f"\n✓ Plan markdown written to {args.output}")
        
        if chat_id:
            metadata = load_metadata()
            
            existing_chat = next((c for c in metadata.chats if c.chat_id == chat_id), None)
            
            now = datetime.now().isoformat()
            
            if existing_chat:
                existing_chat.title = query[:100]
                existing_chat.updated_at = now
            else:
                new_chat = ChatMetadata(
                    chat_id=chat_id,
                    title=query[:100],
                    created_at=now,
                    updated_at=now
                )
                metadata.chats.append(new_chat)
            
            save_metadata(metadata)
            
            plan_model = convert_plan_to_model(plan)
            save_plan(chat_id, plan_model)
            
            print(f"✓ Plan saved to .zoro/generated/assistant/{chat_id}/plan.json")
            print(f"✓ Metadata updated")
        
        return 0
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

from backend.assistant.planner import generate_plan
from backend.assistant.plan_manager import load_metadata, save_metadata, save_plan
from backend.globals.schemas import (
    Plan,
    PlanModel,
    PlanNode,
    PlanEdge,
    ChatMetadata,
    HistoryEntry
)


def format_plan_as_markdown(plan: Plan) -> str:
    md = f"# Plan: {plan.task_query}\n\n"
    
    if plan.good_trajectories or plan.bad_trajectories:
        md += "## Analysis of Past Similar Tasks\n\n"
        
        if plan.good_trajectories:
            md += "### Good Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.good_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
        
        if plan.bad_trajectories:
            md += "### Bad Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.bad_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
    
    if plan.reasoning:
        md += "## Reasoning\n\n"
        md += f"{plan.reasoning}\n\n"
    
    if plan.steps:
        md += "---\n\n## Execution Plan\n\n"
        
        for step in plan.steps:
            md += f"### Step {step.step_number}: [{step.task_type}] {step.objective}\n\n"
            
            if step.substeps:
                md += "**Substeps:**\n"
                for i, substep in enumerate(step.substeps, 1):
                    md += f"{i}. {substep}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.rules:
                md += "**Rules to follow:**\n"
                for rule in step.rules:
                    md += f"- {rule.rule}\n"
                    md += f"  Reasoning: {rule.reasoning}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.failure_point_watch:
                md += f"**Failure point watch:**\n⚠️ {step.failure_point_watch}\n\n"
            
            md += "---\n\n"
    
    return md


def convert_plan_to_model(plan: Plan) -> PlanModel:
    now = datetime.now().isoformat()
    
    nodes = []
    edges = []
    
    for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps):
        node_id = f"step-{step.step_number}"
        
        node = PlanNode(
            id=node_id,
            type=step.task_type if step.task_type in ["checking-with-user", "planning", "implementation", "debugging", "testing"] else "implementation",
            title=step.objective[:100],
            description=step.objective,
            status="pending",
            rules=[],
            data={},
            audit=[]
        )
        
        nodes.append(node)
        
        if i > 0:
            edge = PlanEdge(
                id=f"edge-{i}",
                from_node=f"step-{plan.steps[i-1].step_number}",
                to_node=node_id,
                type="sequence"
            )
            edges.append(edge)
    
    plan_model = PlanModel(
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        nodes=nodes,
        edges=edges,
        history=[
            HistoryEntry(
                at=now,
                action="created",
                details=f"Plan generated for: {plan.task_query}"
            )
        ]
    )
    
    return plan_model


def cmd_plan(args):
    try:
        query = args.query
        chat_id = args.chat_id
        
        plan = generate_plan(query, model='gpt-5')
        
        markdown = format_plan_as_markdown(plan)
        
        if args.output:
            output_path = Path(args.output)
            output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(markdown)
            
            print(f"\n✓ Plan markdown written to {args.output}")
        
        if chat_id:
            metadata = load_metadata()
            
            existing_chat = next((c for c in metadata.chats if c.chat_id == chat_id), None)
            
            now = datetime.now().isoformat()
            
            if existing_chat:
                existing_chat.title = query[:100]
                existing_chat.updated_at = now
            else:
                new_chat = ChatMetadata(
                    chat_id=chat_id,
                    title=query[:100],
                    created_at=now,
                    updated_at=now
                )
                metadata.chats.append(new_chat)
            
            save_metadata(metadata)
            
            plan_model = convert_plan_to_model(plan)
            save_plan(chat_id, plan_model)
            
            print(f"✓ Plan saved to .zoro/generated/assistant/{chat_id}/plan.json")
            print(f"✓ Metadata updated")
        
        return 0
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Box, List, ListItemButton, ListItemText, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { api } from '../services/api';

interface Chat {
  chat_id: string;
  title: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface ChatListProps {
  onChatSelect: (chatId: string) => void;
  selectedChatId: string | null;
}

export function ChatList({ onChatSelect, selectedChatId }: ChatListProps) {
  const [chats, setChats] = useState<Chat[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadChats = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.getAssistantChats();
        if (response.success) {
          setChats(response.chats);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load chats:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    loadChats();
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <Box sx={{ p: 2 }}>Loading...</Box>;
  if (chats.length === 0) return <Box sx={{ p: 2 }}>No chats yet</Box>;

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2 }}>Plans</Typography>
      <List>
        {chats.map(chat => (
          <ListItemButton
            key={chat.chat_id}
            selected={chat.chat_id === selectedChatId}
            onClick={() => onChatSelect(chat.chat_id)}
          >
            <ListItemText 
              primary={chat.title}
              secondary={new Date(chat.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
            />
          </ListItemButton>
        ))}
      </List>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Box, List, ListItemButton, ListItemText, Typography } from '@mui/material';

interface Chat {
  chat_id: string;
  title: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface ChatListProps {
  onChatSelect: (chatId: string) => void;
  selectedChatId: string | null;
}

export function ChatList({ onChatSelect, selectedChatId }: ChatListProps) {
  const [chats, setChats] = useState<Chat[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadChats = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.getAssistantChats();
        if (response.success) {
          setChats(response.chats);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load chats:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    loadChats();
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <Box sx={{ p: 2 }}>Loading...</Box>;
  if (chats.length === 0) return <Box sx={{ p: 2 }}>No plans yet</Box>;

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2 }}>Plans</Typography>
      <List>
        {chats.map(chat => (
          <ListItemButton
            key={chat.chat_id}
            selected={chat.chat_id === selectedChatId}
            onClick={() => onChatSelect(chat.chat_id)}
          >
            <ListItemText 
              primary={chat.title}
              secondary={new Date(chat.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
            />
          </ListItemButton>
        ))}
      </List>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import ReactFlow, {
  Controls,
  Background,
  useNodesState,
  useEdgesState,
  type Node,
  type Edge,
} from 'reactflow';
import 'reactflow/dist/style.css';
import { Box, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { PlanNode } from './PlanNode';

const nodeTypes = {
  default: PlanNode,
};

interface PlanVisualizationProps {
  plan: any | null;
  loading: boolean;
}

export function PlanVisualization({ plan, loading }: PlanVisualizationProps) {
  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!plan) {
      setNodes([]);
      setEdges([]);
      return;
    }

    const flowNodes: Node[] = plan.nodes.map((node: any, i: number) => ({
      id: node.id,
      type: 'default',
      position: { x: 250, y: 100 + i * 150 },
      data: { node },
    }));

    const flowEdges: Edge[] = plan.edges.map((edge: any) => ({
      id: edge.id,
      source: edge.from,
      target: edge.to,
      type: 'smoothstep',
    }));

    setNodes(flowNodes);
    setEdges(flowEdges);
  }, [plan, setNodes, setEdges]);

  if (loading) {
    return <Box sx={{ p: 2 }}><Typography>Loading plan...</Typography></Box>;
  }

  if (!plan) {
    return <Box sx={{ p: 2 }}><Typography>No plan for this chat yet</Typography></Box>;
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
      <ReactFlow
        nodes={nodes}
        edges={edges}
        onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
        onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
        nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
        fitView
      >
        <Controls />
        <Background />
      </ReactFlow>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

from backend.assistant.planner import generate_plan
from backend.assistant.plan_manager import load_metadata, save_metadata, save_plan
from backend.globals.schemas import (
    Plan,
    PlanModel,
    PlanNode,
    PlanEdge,
    ChatMetadata,
    HistoryEntry
)


def format_plan_as_markdown(plan: Plan) -> str:
    md = f"# Plan: {plan.task_query}\n\n"
    
    if plan.good_trajectories or plan.bad_trajectories:
        md += "## Analysis of Past Similar Tasks\n\n"
        
        if plan.good_trajectories:
            md += "### Good Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.good_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
        
        if plan.bad_trajectories:
            md += "### Bad Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.bad_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
    
    if plan.reasoning:
        md += "## Reasoning\n\n"
        md += f"{plan.reasoning}\n\n"
    
    if plan.steps:
        md += "---\n\n## Execution Plan\n\n"
        
        for step in plan.steps:
            md += f"### Step {step.step_number}: [{step.task_type}] {step.objective}\n\n"
            
            if step.substeps:
                md += "**Substeps:**\n"
                for i, substep in enumerate(step.substeps, 1):
                    md += f"{i}. {substep}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.rules:
                md += "**Rules to follow:**\n"
                for rule in step.rules:
                    md += f"- {rule.rule}\n"
                    md += f"  Reasoning: {rule.reasoning}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.failure_point_watch:
                md += f"**Failure point watch:**\n⚠️ {step.failure_point_watch}\n\n"
            
            md += "---\n\n"
    
    return md


def convert_plan_to_model(plan: Plan) -> PlanModel:
    now = datetime.now().isoformat()
    
    nodes = []
    edges = []
    
    for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps):
        node_id = f"step-{step.step_number}"
        
        node = PlanNode(
            id=node_id,
            type=step.task_type if step.task_type in ["checking-with-user", "planning", "implementation", "debugging", "testing"] else "implementation",
            title=step.objective[:100],
            description=step.objective,
            status="pending",
            rules=[],
            data={},
            audit=[]
        )
        
        nodes.append(node)
        
        if i > 0:
            edge = PlanEdge(
                id=f"edge-{i}",
                from_node=f"step-{plan.steps[i-1].step_number}",
                to_node=node_id,
                type="sequence"
            )
            edges.append(edge)
    
    plan_model = PlanModel(
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        nodes=nodes,
        edges=edges,
        history=[
            HistoryEntry(
                at=now,
                action="created",
                details=f"Plan generated for: {plan.task_query}"
            )
        ]
    )
    
    return plan_model


def cmd_plan(args):
    try:
        query = args.query
        chat_id = args.chat_id
        
        plan = generate_plan(query, model='gpt-5')
        
        markdown = format_plan_as_markdown(plan)
        
        if args.output:
            output_path = Path(args.output)
            output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(markdown)
            
            print(f"\n✓ Plan markdown written to {args.output}")
        
        if chat_id:
            metadata = load_metadata()
            
            existing_chat = next((c for c in metadata.chats if c.chat_id == chat_id), None)
            
            now = datetime.now().isoformat()
            
            if existing_chat:
                existing_chat.title = query[:100]

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

from backend.assistant.planner import generate_plan
from backend.assistant.plan_manager import merge_plan, load_metadata, save_metadata
from backend.cli.commands.plan import format_plan_as_markdown, convert_plan_to_model


def cmd_plan_iter(args):
    try:
        query = args.query
        chat_id = args.chat_id
        
        metadata = load_metadata()
        chat = next((c for c in metadata.chats if c.chat_id == chat_id), None)
        
        if not chat:
            print(f"Error: Chat ID '{chat_id}' not found")
            print("Run 'zoro plan' first to create a plan for this chat")
            sys.exit(1)
        
        print(f"Refining plan for chat: {chat.title}")
        
        plan = generate_plan(query, model='gpt-5')
        
        plan_model = convert_plan_to_model(plan)
        
        merged_plan = merge_plan(chat_id, plan_model.nodes, plan_model.edges)
        
        print(f"✓ Merged {len(plan_model.nodes)} nodes into existing plan")
        print(f"✓ Plan saved to .zoro/generated/assistant/{chat_id}/plan.json")
        
        now = datetime.now().isoformat()
        chat.updated_at = now
        save_metadata(metadata)
        
        if args.output:
            markdown = format_plan_as_markdown(plan)
            
            output_path = Path(args.output)
            
            if output_path.exists():
                with open(output_path, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    f.write("\n\n---\n\n")
                    f.write(f"# Refinement: {query}\n\n")
                    f.write(markdown)
            else:
                output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    f.write(markdown)
            
            print(f"✓ Plan markdown written to {args.output}")
        
        return 0
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3

from dotenv import load_dotenv, find_dotenv
load_dotenv(find_dotenv(usecwd=True))

import sys
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import json

from backend.cli.commands import cmd_init, cmd_process, cmd_search, cmd_messages, cmd_plan, cmd_recover
from backend.cli.commands.plan_iter import cmd_plan_iter
from backend.utils import get_project_root

# Config file path
CONFIG_PATH = get_project_root() / ".zoro/config.json"

def load_config():
    if not CONFIG_PATH.exists():
        return None
    
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, 'r') as f:
        return json.load(f)

def save_config(config):
    CONFIG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(config, f, indent=2)

def mark_file_processed(filename):
    config = load_config()
    if not config:
        config = {"user_name": "", "processed_files": []}
    
    if "processed_files" not in config:
        config["processed_files"] = []
    
    if filename not in config["processed_files"]:
        config["processed_files"].append(filename)
        save_config(config)

def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description='Learning system CLI - process chat logs and search rules'
    )
    
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', help='Command to run')
    
    # Process command
    process_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'process',
        help='Process markdown chat logs into tasks and learn rules with trajectory analysis'
    )
    process_parser.add_argument(
        'file_path',
        nargs='?',
        help='Path to markdown chat file (optional - processes all unprocessed files if not provided)'
    )
    process_parser.add_argument(
        '--user-name',
        type=str,
        help='Name of the user for personalized learning (optional - uses config if not provided)'
    )
    
    # Init command
    init_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'init',
        help='Initialize zoro in the current project'
    )
    init_parser.add_argument(
        '--user-name',
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help='Your name for personalized learning'
    )
    
    # Search command
    search_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'search',
        help='Search for relevant rules'
    )
    search_parser.add_argument(
        'query',
        help='Search query string'
    )
    search_parser.add_argument(
        '--limit',
        type=int,
        default=5,
        help='Number of results to return (default: 5)'
    )
    search_parser.add_argument(
        '--output',
        type=str,
        help='Output markdown file path (e.g., .clinerules/context.md)'
    )
    
    # Messages command
    messages_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'messages',
        help='Extract and display user messages from a chat file'
    )
    messages_parser.add_argument(
        'file_path',
        help='Path to markdown chat file'
    )
    
    # Plan command
    plan_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'plan',
        help='Generate execution plan with rules and failure detection'
    )
    plan_parser.add_argument(
        'query',
        help='Task description to plan for'
    )
    plan_parser.add_argument(
        '--chat-id',
        type=str,
        help='Chat ID to associate this plan with (for persistence)'
    )
    plan_parser.add_argument(
        '--output',
        type=str,
        help='Output markdown file path (e.g., .clinerules/zoro_plan.md)'
    )
    
    # Plan-iter command
    plan_iter_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'plan-iter',
        help='Merge new nodes into existing plan (iterative refinement)'
    )
    plan_iter_parser.add_argument(
        'query',
        help='Refinement description'
    )
    plan_iter_parser.add_argument(
        '--chat-id',
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help='Chat ID to merge into'
    )
    plan_iter_parser.add_argument(
        '--output',
        type=str,
        help='Output markdown file path (e.g., .clinerules/zoro_plan.md)'
    )
    
    # Recover command
    recover_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        'recover',
        help='Generate recovery plan when execution goes off-track'
    )
    recover_parser.add_argument(
        'description',
        help='What went wrong (e.g., "jumped to code without confirming flow")'
    )
    
    return parser.parse_args()

def main():
    args = parse_args()
    
    if args.command == 'init':
        cmd_init(args, save_config)
    elif args.command == 'process':
        cmd_process(args, load_config, mark_file_processed)
    elif args.command == 'search':
        cmd_search(args)
    elif args.command == 'messages':
        cmd_messages(args)
    elif args.command == 'plan':
        cmd_plan(args)
    elif args.command == 'plan-iter':
        cmd_plan_iter(args)
    elif args.command == 'recover':
        cmd_recover(args)
    else:
        print("Please specify a command: 'init', 'process', 'search', 'plan', 'plan-iter', 'recover', or 'messages'")
        print("Use --help for more information")
        sys.exit(1)

def cli():
    main()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    cli()

interface FlowNodeData {
  label: string;
  isAnalyzing?: boolean;
  selected?: boolean;
  status?: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'blocked';
}

export function FlowNode({ data, selected }: { data: FlowNodeData; selected?: boolean }) {
  const { label, isAnalyzing, status } = data;
  const isSelected = selected || data.selected;

  // Status-based styling
  const getStatusStyle = () => {
    if (isSelected) {
      return {
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(135, 174, 115, 0.2)',
        border: '2px solid',
        borderColor: 'primary.main',
      };
    }
    
    if (isAnalyzing) {
      return {
        backgroundColor: 'warning.light',
        border: '2px solid',
        borderColor: 'warning.main',
      };
    }

    switch (status) {
      case 'completed':
        return {
          background: 'repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #e0e0e0, #e0e0e0 10px, #f0f0f0 10px, #f0f0f0 20px)',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: '#bdbdbd',
          opacity: 0.7,
        };
      case 'in_progress':
        return {
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.1)',
          border: '2px solid',
          borderColor: 'warning.main',
        };
      case 'blocked':
        return {
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(244, 67, 54, 0.1)',
          border: '2px solid',
          borderColor: 'error.main',
        };
      default:
        return {
          backgroundColor: 'background.paper',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: 'divider',
        };
    }
  };

  return (
    <Paper 
      elevation={0}
      sx={{ 
        p: 2, 
        minWidth: 120,
        maxWidth: 200,
        textAlign: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
        ...getStatusStyle(),
        transition: 'all 0.3s ease',
        animation: isAnalyzing ? 'pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite' : 'none',
        '@keyframes pulse': {
          '0%, 100%': {
            transform: 'scale(1)',
          },
          '50%': {
            transform: 'scale(1.05)',
          },
        },
      }}
    >

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Box, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { Panel, PanelGroup, PanelResizeHandle } from 'react-resizable-panels';
import { ChatList } from './ChatList';
import { PlanVisualization } from './PlanVisualization';
import { DetailsPanel } from '../../design-system/DetailsPanel';
import { api } from '../../services/api';

export function AssistantTab() {
  const [selectedChatId, setSelectedChatId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedNode, setSelectedNode] = useState<any | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedChatId) {
      setPlan(null);
      return;
    }

    const loadPlan = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const response = await api.getPlan(selectedChatId);
        setPlan(response);
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error('Failed to load plan:', error);
        setPlan(null);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    loadPlan();
  }, [selectedChatId]);

  const handleNodeClick = useCallback((node: any) => {
    setSelectedNode(node);
  }, []);

  return (
    <PanelGroup direction="horizontal" style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {/* Chat List Panel */}
      <Panel defaultSize={15} minSize={10} maxSize={30}>
        <ChatList onChatSelect={setSelectedChatId} selectedChatId={selectedChatId} />
      </Panel>

      <PanelResizeHandle style={{ width: '1px', backgroundColor: '#d0d0d0', cursor: 'col-resize' }} />

      {/* Plan Visualization Panel */}
      <Panel>
        {!selectedChatId ? (
          <Box sx={{ p: 2 }}><Typography>Select a chat to view its plan</Typography></Box>
        ) : (
          <PlanVisualization plan={plan} loading={loading} onNodeClick={handleNodeClick} />
        )}
      </Panel>

      {/* Details Panel (conditional) */}
      {selectedNode && (
        <>
          <PanelResizeHandle style={{ width: '1px', backgroundColor: '#d0d0d0', cursor: 'col-resize' }} />
          <Panel defaultSize={25} minSize={20} maxSize={50}>
            <DetailsPanel 
              task={selectedNode}
              onClose={() => setSelectedNode(null)}
            />
          </Panel>
        </>
      )}
    </PanelGroup>
  );
}

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

from backend.assistant.planner import generate_plan
from backend.assistant.plan_manager import load_metadata, save_metadata, save_plan
from backend.globals.schemas import (
    Plan,
    PlanModel,
    PlanNode,
    PlanEdge,
    ChatMetadata,
    HistoryEntry
)


def format_plan_as_markdown(plan: Plan) -> str:
    md = f"# Plan: {plan.task_query}\n\n"
    
    if plan.good_trajectories or plan.bad_trajectories:
        md += "## Analysis of Past Similar Tasks\n\n"
        
        if plan.good_trajectories:
            md += "### Good Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.good_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
        
        if plan.bad_trajectories:
            md += "### Bad Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.bad_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
    
    if plan.reasoning:
        md += "## Reasoning\n\n"
        md += f"{plan.reasoning}\n\n"
    
    if plan.steps:
        md += "---\n\n## Execution Plan\n\n"
        
        for step in plan.steps:
            md += f"### Step {step.step_number}: [{step.task_type}] {step.objective}\n\n"
            
            if step.substeps:
                md += "**Substeps:**\n"
                for i, substep in enumerate(step.substeps, 1):
                    md += f"{i}. {substep}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.rules:
                md += "**Rules to follow:**\n"
                for rule in step.rules:
                    md += f"- {rule.rule}\n"
                    md += f"  Reasoning: {rule.reasoning}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.failure_point_watch:
                md += f"**Failure point watch:**\n⚠️ {step.failure_point_watch}\n\n"
            
            md += "---\n\n"
    
    return md


def convert_plan_to_model(plan: Plan) -> PlanModel:
    now = datetime.now().isoformat()
    
    nodes = []
    edges = []
    
    for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps):
        node_id = f"step-{step.step_number}"
        
        node = PlanNode(
            id=node_id,
            type=step.task_type if step.task_type in ["checking-with-user", "planning", "implementation", "debugging", "testing"] else "implementation",
            title=step.objective[:100],
            description=step.objective,
            status="pending",
            rules=[],
            data={},
            audit=[]
        )
        
        nodes.append(node)
        
        if i > 0:
            edge = PlanEdge(
                id=f"edge-{i}",
                from_node=f"step-{plan.steps[i-1].step_number}",
                to_node=node_id,
                type="sequence"
            )
            edges.append(edge)
    
    plan_model = PlanModel(
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        nodes=nodes,
        edges=edges,
        history=[
            HistoryEntry(
                at=now,
                action="created",
                details=f"Plan generated for: {plan.task_query}"
            )
        ]
    )
    
    return plan_model


def cmd_plan(args):
    try:
        query = args.query
        chat_id = args.chat_id
        
        plan = generate_plan(query, model='gpt-5')
        
        markdown = format_plan_as_markdown(plan)
        
        if args.output:
            output_path = Path(args.output)
            output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(markdown)
            
            print(f"\n✓ Plan markdown written to {args.output}")
        
        if chat_id:
            metadata = load_metadata()
            
            existing_chat = next((c for c in metadata.chats if c.chat_id == chat_id), None)
            
            now = datetime.now().isoformat()
            
            if existing_chat:
                existing_chat.title = query[:100]
                existing_chat.updated_at = now
            else:
                new_chat = ChatMetadata(
                    chat_id=chat_id,
                    title=query[:100],
                    created_at=now,
                    updated_at=now
                )
                metadata.chats.append(new_chat)
            
            save_metadata(metadata)
            
            plan_model = convert_plan_to_model(plan)
            save_plan(chat_id, plan_model)
            
            print(f"✓ Plan saved to .zoro/generated/assistant/{chat_id}/plan.json")
            print(f"✓ Metadata updated")
        
        return 0
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

from backend.assistant.planner import generate_plan
from backend.assistant.plan_manager import load_metadata, save_metadata, save_plan
from backend.globals.schemas import (
    Plan,
    PlanModel,
    PlanNode,
    PlanEdge,
    ChatMetadata,
    HistoryEntry,
    RuleRef
)


def format_plan_as_markdown(plan: Plan) -> str:
    md = f"# Plan: {plan.task_query}\n\n"
    
    if plan.good_trajectories or plan.bad_trajectories:
        md += "## Analysis of Past Similar Tasks\n\n"
        
        if plan.good_trajectories:
            md += "### Good Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.good_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
        
        if plan.bad_trajectories:
            md += "### Bad Trajectories\n"
            for i, traj in enumerate(plan.bad_trajectories, 1):
                md += f"{i}. {traj}\n\n"
    
    if plan.reasoning:
        md += "## Reasoning\n\n"
        md += f"{plan.reasoning}\n\n"
    
    if plan.steps:
        md += "---\n\n## Execution Plan\n\n"
        
        for step in plan.steps:
            md += f"### Step {step.step_number}: [{step.task_type}] {step.objective}\n\n"
            
            if step.substeps:
                md += "**Substeps:**\n"
                for i, substep in enumerate(step.substeps, 1):
                    md += f"{i}. {substep}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.rules:
                md += "**Rules to follow:**\n"
                for rule in step.rules:
                    md += f"- {rule.rule}\n"
                    md += f"  Reasoning: {rule.reasoning}\n"
                md += "\n"
            
            if step.failure_point_watch:
                md += f"**Failure point watch:**\n⚠️ {step.failure_point_watch}\n\n"
            
            md += "---\n\n"
    
    return md


def convert_plan_to_model(plan: Plan) -> PlanModel:
    now = datetime.now().isoformat()
    
    nodes = []
    edges = []
    
    for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps):
        node_id = f"step-{step.step_number}"
        
        node = PlanNode(
            id=node_id,
            type=step.task_type if step.task_type in ["checking-with-user", "planning", "implementation", "debugging", "testing"] else "implementation",
            title=step.objective[:100],
            description=step.objective,
            status="pending",
            rules=[],
            data={},
            audit=[]
        )
        
        nodes.append(node)
        
        if i > 0:
            edge = PlanEdge(
                id=f"edge-{i}",
                from_node=f"step-{plan.steps[i-1].step_number}",
                to_node=node_id,
                type="sequence"
            )
            edges.append(edge)
    
    plan_model = PlanModel(
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        nodes=nodes,
        edges=edges,
        history=[
            HistoryEntry(
                at=now,
                action="created",
                details=f"Plan generated for: {plan.task_query}"
            )
        ]
    )
    
    return plan_model


def cmd_plan(args):
    try:
        query = args.query
        chat_id = args.chat_id
        
        plan = generate_plan(query, model='gpt-5')
        
        markdown = format_plan_as_markdown(plan)
        
        if args.output:
            output_path = Path(args.output)
            output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(markdown)
            
            print(f"\n✓ Plan markdown written to {args.output}")
        
        if chat_id:
            metadata = load_metadata()
            
            existing_chat = next((c for c in metadata.chats if c.chat_id == chat_id), None)
            
            now = datetime.now().isoformat()
            
            if existing_chat:
                existing_chat.title = query[:100]
                existing_chat.updated_at = now
            else:
                new_chat = ChatMetadata(
                    chat_id=chat_id,
                    title=query[:100],
                    created_at=now,
                    updated_at=now
                )
                metadata.chats.append(new_chat)
            
            save_metadata(metadata)
            
            plan_model = convert_plan_to_model(plan)
            save_plan(chat_id, plan_model)
            
            print(f"✓ Plan saved to .zoro/generated/assistant/{chat_id}/plan.json")
            print(f"✓ Metadata updated")
        
        return 0
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)
